examples.en: We run the whole platform on managed Kubernetes across two regions.
examples.zh: 我们的整个平台跑在两个区域的托管 Kubernetes 上。

situation.en: Our workloads run on managed Kubernetes; we only operate the app layer.
situation.zh: 面试官问你们的基础设施，你介绍云上的运行方式。

entries.zh: 托管 Kubernetes（云厂商运维控制面）

examples.en: Everything is defined in Terraform — if it's not in code, it doesn't exist.
examples.zh: 一切都用 Terraform 定义，没写进代码的，就算不存在。

situation.en: We manage it as infrastructure as code, so every change goes through review.
situation.zh: 你介绍团队怎么管理云资源。

examples.en: The load balancer spreads traffic across three availability zones.
examples.zh: 负载均衡器把流量分摊到三个可用区。

situation.en: If one availability zone goes down, the others absorb the traffic.
situation.zh: 设计题里你讲多可用区怎么扛故障。

examples.en: Services inside the VPC can reach the database; nothing from the public internet can.
examples.zh: VPC 内的服务能访问数据库，公网什么都进不来。

situation.en: The database lives in a private subnet inside the VPC.
situation.zh: 你介绍网络隔离的设计。

examples.en: Public subnets hold the load balancers; private subnets hold everything else.
examples.zh: 公有子网放负载均衡器，其余一切放在私有子网。

situation.en: App servers sit in private subnets, behind the load balancer.
situation.zh: 画架构图时你解释子网的划分。

examples.en: The security group only allows port 443 from the load balancer's group.
examples.zh: 这个安全组只允许来自负载均衡器安全组的 443 端口。

situation.en: Check the security group rules first — nine times out of ten, that's the issue.
situation.zh: 同事说服务连不上，你让他先查安全组。

entries.zh: 安全组（云上的虚拟防火墙）

examples.en: The instance gets its permissions from an IAM role, not from stored keys.
examples.zh: 这台机器的权限来自 IAM 角色，不是存着的密钥。

situation.en: Never hardcode credentials — use an IAM role instead.
situation.zh: 评审时你指出代码里硬编码密钥的问题。

entries.zh: IAM 角色（给机器的权限身份）

examples.en: User uploads go straight to object storage; we never stream them through the app servers.
examples.zh: 用户上传直接进对象存储，从不经过应用服务器中转。

situation.en: Backups live in object storage with a ninety-day lifecycle rule.
situation.zh: 你介绍备份方案。

examples.en: Ephemeral storage disappears when the instance stops — never put real data there.
examples.zh: 实例一停，临时存储就没了，千万别往那放真数据。

situation.en: That data was on ephemeral storage, so it's gone.
situation.zh: 复盘时你解释数据为什么丢了。

examples.en: The autoscaler adds instances when CPU stays above seventy percent for five minutes.
examples.zh: CPU 连续五分钟超过 70% 时，自动扩缩器会增加实例。

situation.en: During the sale, autoscaling took us from ten instances to forty.
situation.zh: 你复盘大促当天的扩容情况。

examples.en: We set a hard cap on instances so a bug can't scale our bill to the moon.
examples.zh: 我们给实例数设了硬上限，免得一个 bug 把账单扩到天上去。

entries.note: scale ... to the moon 是口语夸张，指费用失控。账单事故在面试里是很好的故事素材。

situation.en: A runaway retry loop once scaled our bill to the moon overnight.
situation.zh: 讲踩坑经历时你说重试风暴把账单刷爆了。

examples.en: With containers, the same image runs on my laptop and in production — no more 'works on my machine'.
examples.zh: 有了容器，同一个镜像在我电脑上和生产环境跑得一模一样，再没有“我这能跑”了。

situation.en: We ship containers, so the runtime is identical everywhere.
situation.zh: 面试官问你们怎么做环境一致性。

entries.zh: 处处同一个镜像（环境一致性）

examples.en: The orchestrator restarts failed containers and reschedules them onto healthy nodes.
examples.zh: 编排器会重启失败的容器，并把它们重新调度到健康的节点上。

situation.en: Kubernetes is our orchestrator — scheduling, healing, scaling.
situation.zh: 你一句话介绍编排层做什么。

examples.en: Liveness probes restart a stuck container; readiness probes keep traffic away until it's warm.
examples.zh: 存活探针重启卡死的容器，就绪探针在预热完成前不让流量进来。

entries.note: liveness / readiness 两个探针的区别是 K8s 面试的经典题，答反了很扣分。

situation.en: The readiness probe was failing, so the pod never got traffic.
situation.zh: 排查发布问题时你发现就绪探针一直失败。

entries.zh: 就绪探针（决定要不要给流量）

examples.en: We use a rolling update with a small canary batch first.
examples.zh: 我们用滚动更新，先发一个小批次当金丝雀。

situation.en: Rolling update, ten percent at a time, with automatic rollback.
situation.zh: 你介绍发布策略。

examples.en: All traffic from the edge goes through a CDN, so static assets never hit our origin.
examples.zh: 边缘进来的流量先过 CDN，静态资源根本到不了源站。

situation.en: The CDN absorbs most of the read traffic.
situation.zh: 设计题里你用 CDN 挡读流量。

examples.en: A reverse proxy terminates TLS and forwards plain HTTP inside the network.
examples.zh: 反向代理终结 TLS，在内网转发普通 HTTP。

situation.en: Nginx acts as our reverse proxy in front of the app servers.
situation.zh: 你介绍入口流量的处理链。

examples.en: DNS failover moves traffic to the healthy region within a minute.
examples.zh: DNS 故障转移在一分钟内把流量切到健康区域。

situation.en: If the region dies, DNS failover is our first line of defense.
situation.zh: 设计题谈容灾时你讲第一道防线。

examples.en: Egress traffic goes through a NAT gateway, so instances never expose public IPs.
examples.zh: 出口流量走 NAT 网关，实例永不暴露公网 IP。

entries.note: ingress（入）/ egress（出）是一对高频词，安全和网络题里天天见。

situation.en: Only the NAT gateway has a public route out.
situation.zh: 你介绍网络出口的设计。

examples.en: We peered the two VPCs so the data platform can read from the app network.
examples.zh: 我们把两个 VPC 打通对等连接，让数据平台能读应用网络的数据。

situation.en: The VPCs are peered, but the routes are read-only one way.
situation.zh: 你解释跨网络访问的限制。

examples.en: Serverless sounds cheap until your function runs a million times a day.
examples.zh: 无服务器听着便宜，直到你的函数一天跑一百万次。

entries.note: serverless 不是“没有服务器”，是“不用你管服务器”。面试里能说清这一点很加分。

situation.en: For the image resizing, serverless was the right call — spiky, low volume.
situation.zh: 你解释某个场景为什么选无服务器。

examples.en: Cold starts added three hundred milliseconds to the first request after idle.
examples.zh: 闲置后的第一个请求被冷启动多加了三百毫秒。

situation.en: Cold starts were our main complaint about the function setup.
situation.zh: 复盘无服务器方案时你讲主要槽点。

examples.en: Spot instances cut our batch bill by seventy percent, but they can vanish with two minutes' notice.
examples.zh: 竞价实例把批处理账单砍了七成，但它们可能提前两分钟通知就被收走。

situation.en: Batch jobs run on spot instances; user traffic never does.
situation.zh: 你介绍成本优化的分工。

entries.zh: 竞价实例（便宜但可被回收）

examples.en: We moved the reserved capacity to a three-year commitment for the steady baseline.
examples.zh: 我们把稳定基线的容量买成三年预留，省了长期成本。

situation.en: Reserved for the baseline, on-demand for the peaks.
situation.zh: 你一句话总结容量采购策略。

examples.en: The control plane is managed; we only operate the data plane.
examples.zh: 控制面是托管的，我们只运维数据面。

entries.note: control plane / data plane 的区分在系统设计面试里非常常见，答得出很显功底。

situation.en: That outage was in their control plane; our data plane kept serving.
situation.zh: 复盘云厂商故障时你区分影响面。

entries.zh: 控制面（管配置和调度的那层）

examples.en: We keep an eye on egress fees — moving data between regions is where the bill hides.
examples.zh: 我们盯着出口流量费，跨区域搬数据才是账单的大头藏身处。

situation.en: The surprise on the bill was egress fees, not compute.
situation.zh: 你复盘云账单超支的原因。

entries.zh: 出口流量费（云账单刺客）

examples.en: A bastion host is the only SSH entry point, and every session is recorded.
examples.zh: 堡垒机是唯一的 SSH 入口，所有会话都被录像。

situation.en: Nobody SSHs directly — everything goes through the bastion host.
situation.zh: 安全评审时你介绍运维入口的管理。

examples.en: We run active-passive across regions because active-active doubles the data headaches.
examples.zh: 我们跨区域用主备模式，因为双活会让数据问题翻倍。

situation.en: Active-passive is slower to fail over, but far simpler to reason about.
situation.zh: 设计题里你比较两种容灾模式。

examples.en: The recovery time objective is fifteen minutes; the recovery point is five.
examples.zh: 恢复时间目标是十五分钟，恢复点目标是五分钟。

entries.note: RTO（多久恢复）和 RPO（丢多少数据）是容灾题的必答项，别说反了。

situation.en: Our RPO is five minutes — that's the most data we can afford to lose.
situation.zh: 你给设计定容灾指标。

examples.en: Immutable infrastructure means we replace instances instead of patching them.
examples.zh: 不可变基础设施的意思是：我们换实例，而不是给实例打补丁。

situation.en: With immutable infrastructure, a bad deploy is just a rollback to the previous image.
situation.zh: 你解释不可变部署的好处。

examples.en: Drift detection tells us when someone changed a resource by hand in the console.
examples.zh: 漂移检测会告诉我们，有人是不是在控制台里手动改了资源。

situation.en: Config drift caused that incident — someone hotfixed the console directly.
situation.zh: 复盘时你指出配置漂移是事故原因。

examples.en: We tag every resource with team and project, or finance can't split the bill.
examples.zh: 每个资源都打上团队和项目的标签，不然财务没法分账。

situation.en: Untagged resources get flagged in the weekly cost report.
situation.zh: 你介绍成本治理的规则。

entries.zh: 给每个资源打标签（成本分摊）

examples.en: The region outage taught us that a single point of failure can hide in the boring parts — like DNS.
examples.zh: 那次区域故障教会我们：单点故障会藏在最无聊的地方，比如 DNS。

situation.en: Our boring parts — DNS, certificates — caused the last two incidents.
situation.zh: 你总结事故教训时提到不起眼的组件。

entries.zh: 藏在不起眼的地方（指单点/风险）

examples.en: Edge computing pushes the cache and light logic closer to the user.
examples.zh: 边缘计算把缓存和轻逻辑推到离用户更近的地方。

situation.en: Latency-sensitive checks run at the edge, not in the home region.
situation.zh: 设计题里你讲哪些逻辑放边缘。

examples.en: We rehearse region failover every quarter — an untested failover is just a hope.
examples.zh: 我们每季度演练一次区域切换，没演练过的切换只是个希望。

entries.note: untested X is just a hope 这句可以套用在备份、回滚、告警上，是很好的面试句式。

situation.en: An untested backup is just a hope, so we restore one every month.
situation.zh: 你套用这个句式讲备份演练。

entries.term: an untested failover is just a hope
entries.zh: 没演练过的切换只是个希望
